answer: Make every payout require cracking one walnut: a sequential puzzle built around the agent's own kernel, a core computation that cannot be split across cores or shared between clones. At each epoch start a raven courier delivers a fresh, identity-bound nonce, and the puzzle must be finished inside a short window. One honest agent cracks one walnut in time; a farm running many clones must crack them one after another, so most miss the window and earn nothing.
